answer.justification: All logit-level measurements are exactly zero or one: top-1 agreement 1.000, sequence agreement 1.000, KL 0.000, TV 0.000, Token-DiFR gap 0.000, and raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0). That is the signature of the none class. Every tampered class shows a clearly non-zero difference at this level. The smallest is quantization, with KL about 0.05 and top-1 agreement about 0.95, and the system-prompt classes have KL of 0.24 to 0.30. Output and activation levels were not measured, but none of the other classes would give exact zeros at the logit level.
